protocol.test_split_scope: Held out from this selection/training experiment; may be familiar from nominal D0
protocol.collection_rule: First eligible event per requested layout and intervention type; no uncertainty or recovery-outcome filtering
protocol.scope: Single-task induced-error collection/development pool; ACT proxy; not INSIGHT, VLA, or a test set

label_definitions.missed_grasp: Policy close command near target; closure blocked; no established prior lifted hold; empty lift and bowl remains on table
label_definitions.object_dropped: Consecutive bilateral finger contact while target lifted; forced open before goal; target falls >=3cm and bilateral hold lost

selection_notes.scope: Initial candidate query plan; not collected demonstrations or measured recovery success
selection_notes.quota_rule: Repeatedly add one slot to a least-filled nonempty group; seeded ties; exhausted groups skipped
selection_notes.collection_rule: U/Random advance their fixed order after failed attempts. F_ref tries the next candidate in the same type; if exhausted, redistribute unfilled slots by the same quota rule among remaining available groups. Record every attempt. Stop only after B accepted successes, or report an unmet budget.
selection_notes.training_rule: All future variants start from the fixed initial ACT; same training parameters and replay. No old recovery-adapted weights.
selection_notes.evaluation_rule: Use independent common test starts, never states in this collection pool.
